steps.en: One email per unique company owner
steps.id: Satu email untuk setiap pemilik company yang unik

steps.en: The email carries notice number, vehicle, amount and due date
steps.id: Email memuat nomor notice, kendaraan, jumlah dan tanggal jatuh tempo
steps.why_en: Some stages have no company email, and the wording lives in the database.
steps.why_id: Beberapa stage tidak punya email company, dan redaksinya ada di database.

steps.en: Reminder emails are sent in batches to company owners
steps.id: Email pengingat dikirim bertahap ke pemilik company
steps.why_en: The sending job and prod email are switched off in the repo settings.
steps.why_id: Job pengirim dan email di prod dimatikan di pengaturan repo.
